title: Fourier coefficient as a normalized integer sum
statement: Let $\iota$ be a finite index set, let $g$ assign a sign to every sign assignment on $\iota$, and let $S$ be a finite set of indices. The Fourier coefficient of the real-valued function obtained from $g$ by interpreting its output as a real sign, at frequency $S$, is the integer sum of $g(x)$ times the product of the input signs in $S$, interpreted as a real number, divided by the number of sign assignments on $\iota$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ maps sign assignments on $\iota$ to signs
$S$ is a finite set of indices in $\iota$
